category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Primary and Secondary Colours
category_name_et: Kunst ja arhitektuur: Põhi- ja sekundaarvärvid
clue_en: In the traditional painters’ RYB model, which colour joins red and yellow as a primary?
clue_et: Milline värv kuulub maalikunstnike traditsioonilises RYB-mudelis punase ja kollase kõrval põhivärvide hulka?
explanation_en: Blue, red and yellow form the traditional RYB set of primary colours.
explanation_et: Sinine, punane ja kollane moodustavad traditsioonilise RYB-põhivärvide kolmiku.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Primary and Secondary Colours
category_name_et: Kunst ja arhitektuur: Põhi- ja sekundaarvärvid
clue_en: Which secondary colour is made by mixing red and blue paint?
clue_et: Milline sekundaarvärv saadakse punase ja sinise värvi segamisel?
explanation_en: In the RYB model, red and blue pigments combine to make purple or violet.
explanation_et: RYB-mudelis annavad punane ja sinine pigment lilla ehk violetse värvi.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Primary and Secondary Colours
category_name_et: Kunst ja arhitektuur: Põhi- ja sekundaarvärvid
clue_en: On a traditional RYB colour wheel, which secondary colour sits opposite blue?
clue_et: Milline sekundaarvärv asub traditsioonilisel RYB-värviringil sinise vastas?
explanation_en: Blue and orange are complementary colours because they face each other on the RYB wheel.
explanation_et: Sinine ja oranž on komplementaarvärvid, sest nad paiknevad RYB-värviringil vastakuti.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Primary and Secondary Colours
category_name_et: Kunst ja arhitektuur: Põhi- ja sekundaarvärvid
clue_en: In the additive RGB model used by screens, which colour joins red and blue as a primary?
clue_et: Milline värv on ekraanide liitvas RGB-mudelis punase ja sinise kõrval põhivärv?
explanation_en: Screens combine red, green and blue light as the three additive primaries.
explanation_et: Ekraanid ühendavad liitva värvimudeli kolme põhivärvina punast, rohelist ja sinist valgust.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Primary and Secondary Colours
category_name_et: Kunst ja arhitektuur: Põhi- ja sekundaarvärvid
clue_en: Which blue-green printing primary appears beside magenta and yellow in the CMYK colour model?
clue_et: Milline sinakasroheline trükivärvi põhivärv on CMYK-värvimudelis magenta ja kollase kõrval?
explanation_en: Cyan, magenta and yellow are the subtractive colour primaries used by CMYK printing, with black added as the key plate.
explanation_et: Tsüaan, magenta ja kollane on CMYK-trüki lahutavad põhivärvid ning neile lisatakse võtmeplaadina must.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Tools of the Painter
clue_en: Which handheld tool uses bristles to spread paint across a surface?
clue_et: Millise käes hoitava harjastega töövahendiga kantakse värvi pinnale?
explanation_en: A paintbrush holds paint in its bristles and transfers it to canvas or another surface.
explanation_et: Pintsli harjased hoiavad värvi ja kannavad selle lõuendile või muule pinnale.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Tools of the Painter
clue_en: What flat surface does a painter traditionally use to hold and mix colours?
clue_et: Kuidas nimetatakse tasast alust, millel maalikunstnik värve hoiab ja segab?
explanation_en: A painter’s palette provides a portable surface for arranging and mixing paint.
explanation_et: Maalipalett on kaasaskantav alus värvide paigutamiseks ja segamiseks.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Tools of the Painter
clue_en: What upright support holds a canvas while an artist works?
clue_et: Kuidas nimetatakse püstist alust, mis hoiab kunstniku töötamise ajal lõuendit?
explanation_en: An easel is a stand designed to display or support an artist’s canvas.
explanation_et: Molbert on alus, mis on mõeldud kunstniku lõuendi hoidmiseks või eksponeerimiseks.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Tools of the Painter
clue_en: Which blunt, flexible blade can mix paint or apply thick strokes without bristles?
clue_et: Millise tömbi painduva labaga saab värvi segada või kanda peale pakse pintslita kihte?
explanation_en: A palette knife mixes paint, while similar painting knives can lay pigment directly on a surface.
explanation_et: Palettnuga segab värvi ning sarnase maalimisnoaga saab pigmenti otse pinnale kanda.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Tools of the Painter
clue_en: Which tool uses compressed air to spray a fine mist of paint through a small nozzle?
clue_et: Milline tööriist kasutab suruõhku, et pihustada värv läbi väikese düüsi peene uduna?
explanation_en: An airbrush mixes paint with a stream of compressed air to create a controlled, even spray.
explanation_et: Aerograaf ühendab värvi suruõhujoaga, et tekitada juhitav ja ühtlane pihustus.

clue_en: Michelangelo carved his famous David from which pale stone?
clue_et: Millisest heledast kivimist raius Michelangelo oma kuulsa Taaveti?
explanation_en: Michelangelo’s David was carved from a single block of Carrara marble.
explanation_et: Michelangelo Taavet raiuti ühest Carrara marmori plokist.

clue_en: Which copper-and-tin alloy is commonly cast for durable outdoor statues?
clue_et: Millist vase ja tina sulamit valatakse sageli vastupidavateks väliskujudeks?
explanation_en: Bronze flows well in a mould and withstands weather, making it a classic sculpture material.
explanation_et: Pronks täidab valuvormi hästi ja peab ilmastikule vastu, mistõttu on see klassikaline skulptuurimaterjal.

clue_en: Which soft earth-based material can be shaped by hand and hardened by firing?
clue_et: Millist pehmet maapõhist materjali saab käsitsi vormida ja põletades kõvastada?
explanation_en: Clay is plastic when wet and becomes hard ceramic when fired.
explanation_et: Savi on niiskena voolitav ning muutub põletamisel kõvaks keraamikaks.

clue_en: What material is a sculptor carving when gouges reveal a figure inside a tree trunk?
clue_et: Millist materjali töötleb skulptor, kes toob peitlitega puutüvest kuju esile?
explanation_en: Wood carving removes pieces of timber with cutting tools to create a form.
explanation_et: Puunikerduses eemaldatakse lõikeriistadega puitu, et luua soovitud vorm.

clue_en: Which quick-setting white material is poured into moulds and used for sculpture casts?
clue_et: Millist kiiresti tarduvat valget materjali valatakse vormidesse ja kasutatakse skulptuuride jäljendite tegemiseks?
explanation_en: Plaster of Paris sets after mixing with water and is widely used for moulds and casts.
explanation_et: Veega segatud kips tardub ning seda kasutatakse laialt vormide ja valandite valmistamiseks.

clue_en: Which Paris museum houses the Mona Lisa?
clue_et: Millises Pariisi muuseumis asub Mona Lisa?
explanation_en: The Mona Lisa is displayed in the Louvre, the former royal palace beside the Seine.
explanation_et: Mona Lisa on välja pandud Seine’i ääres asuvas endises kuningapalees Louvre’is.

clue_en: Which Madrid museum is especially famous for Spanish masters such as Velázquez and Goya?
clue_et: Milline Madridi muuseum on eriti kuulus Hispaania meistrite, näiteks Velázqueze ja Goya poolest?
explanation_en: The Prado’s collection is centred on European art and is particularly rich in Spanish painting.
explanation_et: Prado kogu keskendub Euroopa kunstile ja on eriti rikas Hispaania maalikunsti poolest.

clue_en: Which Florence gallery is known for Botticelli’s The Birth of Venus?
clue_et: Milline Firenze galerii on tuntud Botticelli „Veenuse sünni” poolest?
explanation_en: The Birth of Venus belongs to the Uffizi Gallery’s celebrated Renaissance collection.
explanation_et: „Veenuse sünd” kuulub Uffizi galerii kuulsasse renessansikogusse.

clue_en: Which Amsterdam museum displays Rembrandt’s The Night Watch?
clue_et: Millises Amsterdami muuseumis on välja pandud Rembrandti „Öine vahtkond”?
explanation_en: The Night Watch is one of the best-known works in the Rijksmuseum’s Dutch collection.
explanation_et: „Öine vahtkond” on Rijksmuseumi Hollandi kunstikogu üks tuntumaid teoseid.

clue_en: Which vast St Petersburg museum occupies the Winter Palace and neighbouring buildings?
clue_et: Milline hiiglaslik Peterburi muuseum paikneb Talvepalees ja selle naaberhoonetes?
explanation_en: The State Hermitage Museum’s main complex includes the former imperial Winter Palace.
explanation_et: Riikliku Ermitaaži peahoonekompleksi kuulub endine keiserlik Talvepalee.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Masters of the Renaissance
clue_en: Which Renaissance master painted the Mona Lisa?
clue_et: Milline renessansimeister maalis Mona Lisa?
explanation_en: Leonardo painted the portrait known as the Mona Lisa during the Italian Renaissance.
explanation_et: Leonardo maalis Mona Lisana tuntud portree Itaalia renessansi ajal.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Masters of the Renaissance
clue_en: Which Florentine sculptor created the towering marble David?
clue_et: Milline Firenze skulptor lõi kõrge marmorist Taaveti?
explanation_en: Michelangelo carved David, a defining work of High Renaissance sculpture.
explanation_et: Michelangelo raius Taaveti, ühe kõrgrenessansi skulptuuri tähtteose.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Masters of the Renaissance
clue_en: Who painted The School of Athens in the Vatican, filling it with ancient philosophers?
clue_et: Kes maalis Vatikanis „Ateena kooli”, täites selle antiikfilosoofidega?
explanation_en: Raphael’s Vatican fresco imagines Plato, Aristotle and other classical thinkers together.
explanation_et: Raffaeli Vatikani freskol on koos kujutatud Platonit, Aristotelest ja teisi antiikmõtlejaid.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Masters of the Renaissance
clue_en: Which Florentine painter showed Venus arriving on a shell in a famous Renaissance work?
clue_et: Milline Firenze kunstnik kujutas kuulsal renessansimaalil merekarbil saabuvat Veenust?
explanation_en: Botticelli painted The Birth of Venus, with the goddess standing on a giant shell.
explanation_et: Botticelli maalis „Veenuse sünni”, kus jumalanna seisab hiiglaslikul merekarbil.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Masters of the Renaissance
clue_en: Which sculptor made an early Renaissance bronze David wearing a distinctive hat?
clue_et: Milline skulptor lõi vararenessansis iseloomuliku kübaraga pronks-Taaveti?
accepted_variants_en: Donato di Niccolò di Betto Bardi
accepted_variants_et: Donato di Niccolò di Betto Bardi
explanation_en: Donatello’s bronze David is an influential free-standing nude of the early Renaissance.
explanation_et: Donatello pronks-Taavet on vararenessansi mõjukas vabalt seisev aktiskulptuur.

clue_en: Which painter of water lilies became the best-known name of French Impressionism?
clue_et: Millisest vesirooside maalijast sai Prantsuse impressionismi tuntuim nimi?
explanation_en: Monet was a founder of Impressionism and repeatedly painted his garden and water-lily pond.
explanation_et: Monet oli impressionismi rajaja ning maalis korduvalt oma aeda ja vesiroositiiki.

clue_en: Which Impressionist painted lively social scenes such as Dance at Le Moulin de la Galette?
clue_et: Milline impressionist maalis elavaid seltskonnastseene, näiteks „Tants Moulin de la Galette’is”?
explanation_en: Renoir’s painting shows Parisians dancing and socialising at an outdoor café.
explanation_et: Renoiri maal kujutab pariislasi vabaõhukohvikus tantsimas ja suhtlemas.
source_title: Dance at Le Moulin de la Galette — Wikipedia

clue_en: Which Impressionist is especially associated with paintings and sculptures of ballet dancers?
clue_et: Millist impressionisti seostatakse eriti balletitantsijate maalide ja skulptuuridega?
explanation_en: Degas repeatedly studied dancers in rehearsals, on stage and at rest.
explanation_et: Degas kujutas tantsijaid korduvalt proovides, laval ja puhkehetkedel.

clue_en: Which American Impressionist is known for tender paintings of mothers and children?
clue_et: Milline Ameerika impressionist on tuntud ema ja last hellalt kujutavate maalide poolest?
explanation_en: Cassatt exhibited with the Impressionists in Paris and often portrayed women and children in everyday settings.
explanation_et: Cassatt esines Pariisis koos impressionistidega ning kujutas sageli naisi ja lapsi igapäevastes olukordades.

clue_en: Which harbour painting by Monet inspired the name of the Impressionist movement?
clue_et: Milline Monet’ sadamavaatega maal andis nime impressionistide liikumisele?
explanation_en: A critic used the title Impression, Sunrise when mockingly labelling the new artists “Impressionists”.
explanation_et: Kriitik lähtus uute kunstnike pilkaval nimetamisel „impressionistideks” maali „Impressioon. Tõusev päike” pealkirjast.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Famous Paintings at a Glance
category_name_et: Kunst ja arhitektuur: Kuulsad maalid ühe pilguga
clue_en: Which painting swirls a bright night sky above a quiet village and a dark cypress?
clue_et: Millisel maal keerleb hele öötaevas vaikse küla ja tumeda küpressi kohal?
explanation_en: The Starry Night transforms the view from the artist’s Saint-Rémy asylum room into a dramatic imagined sky.
explanation_et: „Tähine öö” muudab kunstniku Saint-Rémy varjupaigatoa vaate dramaatiliseks kujutluslikuks taevaks.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Famous Paintings at a Glance
category_name_et: Kunst ja arhitektuur: Kuulsad maalid ühe pilguga
clue_en: Which painting shows an anxious figure holding its face beneath a blazing red-orange sky?
clue_et: Millisel maal hoiab ärev figuur käsi näol lõõmava punakasoranži taeva all?
explanation_en: Edvard Munch created several versions of The Scream, whose central figure became an international image of anxiety.
explanation_et: Edvard Munch lõi „Karjest” mitu versiooni ning selle keskfiguurist sai rahvusvaheline ärevuse sümbol.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Famous Paintings at a Glance
category_name_et: Kunst ja arhitektuur: Kuulsad maalid ühe pilguga
clue_en: Which Salvador Dalí painting is famous for soft, melting clocks in a strange landscape?
clue_et: Milline Salvador Dalí maal on kuulus kummalises maastikus sulavate pehmete kellade poolest?
explanation_en: The Persistence of Memory uses melting watches as one of Surrealism’s most recognisable images.
explanation_et: „Mälu püsivus” kasutab sulavaid taskukelli ühe sürrealismi kõige tuntuma kujundina.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Famous Paintings at a Glance
category_name_et: Kunst ja arhitektuur: Kuulsad maalid ühe pilguga
clue_en: Which golden Gustav Klimt painting wraps an embracing couple in richly patterned robes?
clue_et: Millisel Gustav Klimti kuldsel maalil on embav paar mähitud rikkalikult mustrilistesse rõivastesse?
explanation_en: The Kiss belongs to Klimt’s Golden Period and surrounds the couple with gold leaf and ornament.
explanation_et: „Suudlus” kuulub Klimti kuldsesse perioodi ning ümbritseb paari kuldlehe ja ornamentidega.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Famous Paintings at a Glance
category_name_et: Kunst ja arhitektuur: Kuulsad maalid ühe pilguga
clue_en: Which Edward Hopper painting looks through a diner window at late-night customers on a quiet city street?
clue_et: Millisel Edward Hopperi maalil näeme läbi söögikoha akna hilisõhtuseid külastajaid vaiksel linnatänaval?
explanation_en: Nighthawks shows a brightly lit New York diner whose customers seem isolated from the dark street outside.
explanation_et: „Nighthawks” kujutab eredalt valgustatud New Yorgi söögikohta, mille külastajad näivad pimedast tänavast eraldatud.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Modern Artists and Their Signature Looks
category_name_et: Kunst ja arhitektuur: Moodsa kunsti meistrite tunnusstiilid
clue_en: Which huge black-and-white painting protests the bombing of a Basque town during the Spanish Civil War?
clue_et: Milline hiiglaslik mustvalge maal protestib ühe baski linna pommitamise vastu Hispaania kodusõjas?
explanation_en: Guernica responds to the destruction of the town and became an international anti-war image.
explanation_et: „Guernica” reageerib linna hävitamisele ja sellest sai rahvusvaheline sõjavastane sümbol.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Modern Artists and Their Signature Looks
category_name_et: Kunst ja arhitektuur: Moodsa kunsti meistrite tunnusstiilid
clue_en: Which Pop artist turned Campbell’s soup cans and celebrity portraits into gallery icons?
clue_et: Milline popkunstnik muutis Campbelli supipurgid ja kuulsuste portreed galeriikunsti ikoonideks?
explanation_en: Andy Warhol used familiar products and mass-media images to blur the line between advertising and fine art.
explanation_et: Andy Warhol kasutas tuttavaid tooteid ja massimeedia pilte, hägustades reklaami ja kujutava kunsti piiri.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Modern Artists and Their Signature Looks
category_name_et: Kunst ja arhitektuur: Moodsa kunsti meistrite tunnusstiilid
clue_en: Which Mexican artist is known for vivid self-portraits featuring her unmistakable eyebrows, animals and plants?
clue_et: Milline Mehhiko kunstnik on tuntud erksate autoportreede poolest, kus näeb tema äratuntavaid kulme, loomi ja taimi?
explanation_en: Frida Kahlo repeatedly used her own image to explore identity, pain and Mexican culture.
explanation_et: Frida Kahlo kasutas oma kujutist korduvalt identiteedi, valu ja Mehhiko kultuuri käsitlemiseks.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Modern Artists and Their Signature Looks
category_name_et: Kunst ja arhitektuur: Moodsa kunsti meistrite tunnusstiilid
clue_en: Which Dutch artist is famous for black grids filled with blocks of red, blue, yellow and white?
clue_et: Milline Hollandi kunstnik on kuulus mustade ruudustike ning punaste, siniste, kollaste ja valgete värvipindade poolest?
explanation_en: Mondrian reduced paintings to straight black lines and primary-colour rectangles in his mature abstract style.
explanation_et: Mondrian taandas oma küpses abstraktses stiilis maalid sirgetele mustadele joontele ja põhivärvi ristkülikutele.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Modern Artists and Their Signature Looks
category_name_et: Kunst ja arhitektuur: Moodsa kunsti meistrite tunnusstiilid
clue_en: Which Japanese artist fills pumpkins, rooms and mirrored installations with repeating polka dots?
clue_et: Milline Jaapani kunstnik katab kõrvitsad, ruumid ja peegelinstallatsioonid korduvate täppidega?
explanation_en: Yayoi Kusama made repeated dots and immersive Infinity Mirror Rooms central to her art.
explanation_et: Yayoi Kusama muutis korduvad täpid ja ümbritsevad lõpmatuse peegelruumid oma kunsti keskseks osaks.

clue_en: What kind of painting shows outdoor scenery such as mountains, forests or fields?
clue_et: Milline maaliliik kujutab väliseid vaateid, näiteks mägesid, metsi või põlde?
explanation_en: A landscape makes natural scenery the main subject of the picture.
explanation_et: Maastikumaal kujutab pildi peamise teemana loodusvaadet.

clue_en: Which floating flowers inspired a vast series painted from the garden pond at Giverny?
clue_et: Millised veepinnal ujuvad lilled inspireerisid Giverny aiatiigi põhjal loodud suurt maaliseeriat?
explanation_en: The Water Lilies series studies the reflections, plants and changing light of the garden pond.
explanation_et: „Vesirooside” sari uurib aiatiigi peegeldusi, taimi ja muutuvat valgust.

clue_en: Which yellow flowers gave their name to a famous series of paintings by Vincent van Gogh?
clue_et: Millised kollased lilled andsid nime Vincent van Goghi kuulsale maaliseeriale?
explanation_en: Van Gogh painted several famous still lifes of sunflowers in vases.
explanation_et: Van Gogh maalis mitu kuulsat natüürmorti vaasi pandud päevalilledest.

clue_en: What art term describes a picture of arranged objects such as fruit, flowers or bottles?
clue_et: Milline kunstimõiste tähistab pilti, millel on paigutatud esemed, näiteks puuviljad, lilled või pudelid?
explanation_en: A still life uses arranged inanimate objects as its main subject.
explanation_et: Natüürmordi põhiteema on paigutatud elutud esemed.

clue_en: What kind of image does a camera create when it captures a natural scene?
clue_et: Millise kujutise loob kaamera loodusvaadet jäädvustades?
explanation_en: A photograph records light from a scene using a camera.
explanation_et: Foto salvestab kaamera abil vaatelt tuleva valguse.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Art across the Ages
category_name_et: Kunst ja arhitektuur: Kunst läbi aegade
clue_en: Which portrait in the Louvre is famous for its sitter’s elusive smile?
clue_et: Milline Louvre’is asuv portree on kuulus modelli tabamatu naeratuse poolest?
explanation_en: The Mona Lisa’s subtly modelled expression is one reason the portrait became so celebrated.
explanation_et: Mona Lisa peenelt modelleeritud ilme on üks põhjus, miks portree nii kuulsaks sai.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Art across the Ages
category_name_et: Kunst ja arhitektuur: Kunst läbi aegade
clue_en: What kind of prehistoric art was painted directly onto rock walls in places such as Lascaux?
clue_et: Millist eelajaloolist kunsti maaliti otse kaljuseintele sellistes paikades nagu Lascaux?
explanation_en: Cave paintings preserve animals, signs and human activity on the walls and ceilings of prehistoric caves.
explanation_et: Koopamaalid säilitavad eelajalooliste koobaste seintel ja lagedel loomi, märke ning inimtegevust.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Art across the Ages
category_name_et: Kunst ja arhitektuur: Kunst läbi aegade
clue_en: Which Renaissance artist painted the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel?
clue_et: Milline renessansikunstnik maalis Sixtuse kabeli lae?
explanation_en: Michelangelo painted the vast Sistine Chapel ceiling frescoes in the early 16th century.
explanation_et: Michelangelo maalis Sixtuse kabeli ulatuslikud laefreskod 16. sajandi alguses.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Art across the Ages
category_name_et: Kunst ja arhitektuur: Kunst läbi aegade
clue_en: Which famous sculpture shows a seated man leaning forward with his chin resting on one hand?
clue_et: Milline kuulus skulptuur kujutab ettepoole kummardunud istuvat meest, kelle lõug toetub käele?
explanation_en: Auguste Rodin created The Thinker as a powerful image of a person absorbed in thought.
explanation_et: Auguste Rodin lõi „Mõtleja” võimsa kujutisena sügavasse mõttesse vajunud inimesest.

category_name_en: Art & Architecture: Art across the Ages
category_name_et: Kunst ja arhitektuur: Kunst läbi aegade
clue_en: What digital art style builds images from deliberately visible tiny coloured squares?
clue_et: Milline digitaalkunsti stiil loob kujutised teadlikult nähtavatest pisikestest värvilistest ruutudest?
explanation_en: Pixel art arranges individual pixels by hand, a look strongly associated with early computer and video-game graphics.
explanation_et: Pikslikunst paigutab üksikud pikslid käsitsi ning seda ilmet seostatakse eriti varaste arvuti- ja videomängude graafikaga.

clue_en: Which Leonardo portrait is also known by the Italian name La Gioconda?
clue_et: Millist Leonardo portreed tuntakse ka itaaliakeelse nimega La Gioconda?
explanation_en: La Gioconda is the Italian title commonly used for the Mona Lisa.
explanation_et: La Gioconda on Mona Lisa tavapärane itaaliakeelne pealkiri.

clue_en: Which Vermeer portrait-like painting shows a young woman turning toward us in a blue-and-gold turban?
clue_et: Millisel Vermeeri portreelaadsel maalil pöördub sinikuldse turbaniga neiu vaataja poole?
accepted_variants_en: The Girl with a Pearl Earring
explanation_en: Vermeer’s tronie focuses on an imagined character, dramatic glance and shining earring.
explanation_et: Vermeeri troonie keskendub kujuteldavale tegelasele, dramaatilisele pilgule ja säravale kõrvarõngale.
source_title: Girl with a Pearl Earring — Wikipedia

clue_en: Which Grant Wood painting pairs a stern farmer holding a pitchfork with a woman beside him?
clue_et: Millisel Grant Woodi maalil seisavad kõrvuti tõsine hanguga talunik ja naine?
explanation_en: American Gothic was inspired by an Iowa house and uses the figures to suggest rural American life.
explanation_et: „Ameerika gootika” sai inspiratsiooni Iowa majast ning figuurid vihjavad Ameerika maaelule.

clue_en: Which Jan van Eyck double portrait shows a richly dressed couple holding hands in a Bruges room?
clue_et: Millisel Jan van Eycki kaksikportreel hoiab rikkalikult riietatud paar Brugge toas käest kinni?
explanation_en: The Arnolfini Portrait is renowned for its detailed interior, convex mirror and complex symbolism.
explanation_et: „Arnolfini portree” on kuulus detailse interjööri, kumera peegli ja mitmekihilise sümboolika poolest.
